When I try to save a link I've already got, I'd much rather the app tell me it's already there and take me to the existing one — that way I avoid ending up with two of the same and I can just update the one I have. Being able to make a second copy on purpose, like in Version B, isn't something I want; that's exactly the clutter I'm trying to get away from. And treating addresses that differ only by a trailing slash as the same link, while keeping genuinely different pages separate, is the right call. Let's go with Version A.
